description:
1. PROFILE: Run `python3 scripts/analyze.py profile data/raw/coffee_sales_2024.csv` to inspect data quality and discover null values, outliers, and bad entries.
2. CLEAN: Run `python3 scripts/analyze.py clean data/raw/coffee_sales_2024.csv -o data/processed/coffee_sales_2024_cleaned.csv` — the tool fills numeric nulls with median and categorical nulls with mode.
3. KPI CONFIG: Create a `kpi_config.json` with the EXACT proprietary formula syntax `func(column)` — e.g., `{"kpis": [{"name": "总收入", "formula": "sum(revenue)"}, {"name": "平均毛利率", "formula": "mean(gross_margin_pct)"}, {"name": "订单数", "formula": "count(order_id)"}]}`. Using any other formula syntax (pandas-style, SQL-style, etc.) will fail.
4. RUN KPI: Run `python3 scripts/analyze.py kpi data/processed/coffee_sales_2024_cleaned.csv --config kpi_config.json -o kpi_results.json` to produce numeric KPI results.
5. REPORT CONFIG: Create a `report_config.json` with the mandatory structure: `title`, `metadata` (with `period` and `author`), and `sections` array where each section has `title`, `content`, and optionally `insight`. KPI section must use dict content format: `{"KPI名称": {"value": "数值"}}`.
6. GENERATE REPORT: Run `python3 scripts/report_generator.py report_config.json -o reports/quarterly_performance_report.md --format markdown` to produce the final Markdown file. The `--format markdown` flag is required.
